feel good feelings. Those are positive valence, right, on this particular map. Negative valence
on the opposite side is going to be emotions that feel bad or negative. Things, ones that think of
like fear, frustration, anxiety, FOMO, anger, all of these are negative valence, right? They're a little

emotions. So this comes down to how am I saying this emotion? Valence is what I'm saying. Intensity

they want. So aspirational marketing is almost always positive valence. Negative valence on the
